title: Prognostic Value of Pre-Treatment 18FDG-PET in Operable Breast Cancer
author: Vincent Vinh-Hung
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bf7jjrkn
materials: The breast tumor is a primary sarcoma
Surgery was done for palliation, for symptom control
Number of examined axillary lymph nodes

steps.title: Screen Patients
steps.instruction: Evaluate patients based on established inclusion and exclusion criteria.

substeps.instruction: Identify metastatic disease using imaging modes other than FDG-PET

steps.title: Analyze PET Positivity Patterns
steps.instruction: Assess the visual pathologically increased uptake patterns of PET positivity across specific anatomical regions.

steps.title: Calculate SUVmax Values
steps.instruction: Determine the Standard uptake value (SUV) based on regions of interests.

substeps.instruction: Measure SUVmax within right and left breast
Measure SUVmax in right and left axillary-supraclavicular region
Measure SUVmax in internal mammary nodes

steps.title: Record Disease Status
steps.instruction: Document the disease status at the last follow-up as either NED (no evidence of disease) or WD (with cancer).

steps.title: Perform Statistical Analysis
steps.instruction: Conduct descriptive and relational statistics on clinical-pathological characteristics and PET uptake patterns.

steps.title: Evaluate Survival Metrics
steps.instruction: Analyze Disease-free survival (DFS) and Overall survival (OS).

substeps.instruction: Define DFS event as any local-regional or distant recurrence, new primary tumor, or death from any cause
Define OS event as death from any cause

steps.title: Conduct Explorative Analyses
steps.instruction: Perform multivariate Cox regression analyses of DFS and OS to evaluate the prognostic value of PET positivity patterns.

substeps.instruction: Use indexes of the proportion of variation explained by covariates

steps.title: Handle Missing Data
steps.instruction: Address missing data based on the percentage of cases affected.

substeps.instruction: If missing in <10% of cases, impute using multivariate imputation by chained equations
If missing in 10% or more, consider separate analyses
